# Contributing

<!-- Generated by seed-golden-context | Last updated: 2026-05-11 -->

## Prerequisites

| Tool | Version | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| PHP | ^8.2 | Required by `composer.json` |
| Composer | 2.x | [Install Composer](https://getcomposer.org/download/) |

No Docker required. No additional env tokens needed for unit tests — the test suite uses the public Contentful example space (`cfexampleapi`) with a well-known delivery token.

## Getting Started

```bash
# Clone and install
git clone git@github.com:contentful/contentful-laravel.git
cd contentful-laravel
composer install

# Run tests
composer test

# Run tests (stop on first failure, no coverage)
composer test-quick-fail

# Static analysis
composer lint-static-analysis
```

## Development Workflow

This is a single-package library with no build step. The typical dev loop is:

```bash
# Verify everything passes
composer test-quick-fail && composer lint-static-analysis
```

## Testing

- **Framework:** PHPUnit (^8.5 | ^9.0 | ^10.0 | ^11.0)
- **Test harness:** Orchestra Testbench (boots a minimal Laravel app without a full host application)
- **Location:** `tests/` — mirrors `src/` structure under `tests/Unit/`
- **Run all:** `composer test`
- **Run all (stop on first failure):** `composer test-quick-fail`
- **Coverage report:** `build/coverage/` (HTML) and `build/logs/clover.xml` (Clover)
- **Config for tests:** `phpunit.xml.dist` — sets env vars to the public example space

### Test environment variables (set in `phpunit.xml.dist`)

| Variable | Value used in tests |
|---|---|
| `CONTENTFUL_SPACE_ID` | `cfexampleapi` |
| `CONTENTFUL_DELIVERY_TOKEN` | `b4c0n73n7fu1` |
| `CONTENTFUL_ENVIRONMENT_ID` | `master` |
| `CONTENTFUL_USE_PREVIEW` | `1` |
| `CONTENTFUL_DEFAULT_LOCALE` | `en-US` |

## Commit Convention

This repo uses [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/):

```
type(scope): description
```

Valid types: `feat`, `fix`, `chore`, `docs`, `refactor`, `test`, `perf`, `ci`, `build`, `revert`

Examples:
```
feat: add Laravel 14 support
fix: handle nullable defaultLocale config
chore: update phpstan to v2
```

## Branch Strategy

- `master` — the stable mainline; all releases are tagged from here
- Feature/fix branches — use descriptive names matching the conventional commit type, e.g., `feat/laravel-14-support`, `fix/preview-api-toggle`
- CI runs on push to `master` and on pull requests

## Release Process

Releases are tagged from `master`. The release script is invoked via:

```bash
composer release
```

This calls `vendor/contentful/core/scripts/release.php`. The CHANGELOG is maintained manually in `CHANGELOG.md` following [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/) + [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/).

## Pull Requests

- Target `master`
- Ensure `composer test-quick-fail` and `composer lint-static-analysis` pass before requesting review
- Update `CHANGELOG.md` under `[Unreleased]` with a summary of changes
- For new Laravel/PHP version support: update `composer.json` constraints, CI matrix, and `README.md`

## CI/CD

| Job | Trigger | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| CodeQL (GitHub Actions) | Push/PR to `master` (workflow files only) | Scans GitHub Actions workflow files for security issues |

Note: The main PHP test matrix (multi-version PHPUnit/Laravel/PHP runs) is run via CircleCI (legacy — `.circleci/` config). The GitHub Actions config currently only contains the CodeQL workflow.
